caption: The video captures a workshop scene with a worn metal tabletop set before green storage cabinets. Centered on the table is a wide cylindrical base painted with yellow-and-black diagonal hazard stripes, into which a taller smooth gray cylinder stands. A ring of curled metal chips rests on the top face around the gray cylinder, with loose spirals scattered across the tabletop. The ring at the cylinder's foot gradually clears, as several curled pieces tumble over the front edge of the base and down its striped side, leaving a widening clean annular ring on the top face. The gray cylinder and the striped base stay in the same relative position throughout, with no visible descent. The loose spirals on the tabletop remain undisturbed, and the green cabinets continue to fill the background.
